eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 23rd Annual IEEE International Conference on Sensing, Communication, and Networking (SECON)
eventDetail.keywords: Internet of Things, Wireless Networking, Wireless Sensing, Wireless Sensor Networks, Mobile Sensor Networks,
eventDetail.scope: The 23rd annual IEEE International Conference on Sensing, Communication, and Networking will provide a unique forum to exchange innovative research ideas, recent results, and share experiences among researchers and practitioners in wireless and mobile-networking communications. This conference aims to serve as the reference exhibit for state-of-the-art research supported by implementation and insights gained on all scales of experimental systems, network architectures, components, and protocols
